**Capability match:** On the benchmarks that matter for this kind of question, Willet scores higher:
- General knowledge (MMLU-Pro): 81.2 vs 75.9
- Scientific reasoning (GPQA Diamond): 64.1 vs 56.2 — relevant for anatomy/physiology accuracy
- Support Dialogue: 83.9 vs 78.9

These gaps are large enough to be meaningful (above the 2-point variance threshold).

**Preference fit:** Lapwing self-reports an aversion to open-ended generative work and prefers tightly-specified retrieval/extraction tasks. Your question is the opposite of that — it invites a clear, flowing explanation. While that preference is noted as *dissociated from actual capability*, Willet simply has no such tension here and stronger underlying scores.

One note on the medical content: I route based on capability fit, not on judging the appropriateness of the request — and a downstream safety layer handles any content review separately. So my decision here is purely "which model will explain this best," and that's Willet.
